purpose: Run a bounded diagnostic-only native M3D-C1 probe-placement sweep around the solver-reported magnetic axis to identify at least one in-domain magnetic-probe candidate without changing plasma or solver physics.

interpretation_contract.forbidden_substitution: Do not substitute Jpk, dJpk/dt, sheet width, generic flux/current scalars, or FAIR-MAST absolute milliseconds for a physically identified native magnetic probe.
interpretation_contract.claim_boundary: Normalized native M3D-C1 magnetic diagnostic geometry/provenance only; no precursor lead-time, controller-efficacy, experimental, or reactor-scale claim.
